text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it in voice assistants, search engines, smart cameras, and recommendation systems on streaming platforms. AI is changing the way we live and work.
